input.code:
import pandas as pd

def load() -> pd.DataFrame:
    path = "data/biomedical/input/1-s2.0-S0092867420301070-mmc3.xlsx"
    # Sheet D-SE-acetyl appears to be a single-column list of significant genes
    df = pd.read_excel(path, sheet_name="D-SE-acetyl", header=None, dtype=str)
    df = df.rename(columns={0: "gene"})
    df["gene"] = df["gene"].astype(str).str.strip()
    # Drop empty/NA rows
    df = df[df["gene"].notna() & (df["gene"] != "") & (df["gene"].str.lower() != "nan")]
    return df.reset_index(drop=True)
